title: Pricing
description: Cards comparing subscription plans, in four layouts. Each plan’s icon plays when you hover over its card.
pageTitle: Pricing Table Cards in 4 Layouts | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it for SaaS plans, memberships or service tiers, wherever people compare options side by side. Four layouts let you match the cards to your page. In three of the layouts, each plan's icon plays on hover, giving every tier its own personality.
whenToUse.alt: Animated pricing cards comparing subscription plans: each plan icon plays on hover

accessibility: Each plan is an article with its name as a heading and features in a real list.
Icons and feature ticks are decorative and hidden from screen readers.
iconsNote: The icons here use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. The default animation works best, but the Loop state, or the Morph state with the morph-on-hover trigger, will look great too.
